In this video, we deep dive into Delta Lake performance optimization using OPTIMIZE with Z-ORDER and VACUUM. You’ll see exactly what happens behind the scenes at the file level, how small files are compacted, how Z-Order improves query performance, and how Delta tables retain or clean up historical files.
What you’ll learn:
What is OPTIMIZE and how Delta compacts small files
Why too many small files slow Spark performance
How Z-ORDER organizes data for faster reads
When to use Z-ORDER and when to avoid it
File-level demo: how Delta merges small Parquet files
